WPE2003.description: This course focuses on improving students' self-learning abilities in the exploration of Chinese classics through studying in-depth selected readings in Confucianism and Neo-Confucianism on sage learning and whole person education, including but not limited to the Five Classics (WuJing) and Four Books (SiShu). It aims to cultivate students' awareness of Chinese traditional culture, enhance students' sense of responsibility and mission to inherit and carry forward Chinese traditional culture and core values, and strengthen students' consciousness of cultural subjects and cultural innovation.

GCAP3043.description: This course aims to provide theoretical perspectives, methods and tools for students to understand the connection of man and nature. Starting from the history, current situation and trend of sustainable development and environmental participation in mainland China, it equips students with conceptual and practical knowledge of environmental challenge, environmental collaboration, environmental communication, environmental education, participation and awareness.
GCAP3043.description_cn: Man and Nature in Whole Person Perspective 全人视角下的人与 自然

WPEX1013.description: This course uses Emotional Intelligence (EI) as its framework, embodied and mindfulness-based practices as its pedagogy, and real-life application as its ultimate goal. It helps students develop conceptual understanding, embodied awareness, and practical skills to be well physically, mentally, and spiritually. Through guided practice, dialogue, and reflection, students learn to connect theory with daily life. By the end of the course, students will be able to: understand key EI concepts, recognize their own emotional and behavioral patterns, build foundational skills in emotion regulation and empathy, and apply their learning to real-life contexts.

WPEX2023.description: The course equips students with philanthropy knowledge, attitude and skills, to broaden their horizons and cultivate multiple understanding of society, and to develop them into tolerant and thoughtful citizens with philanthropic spirit.
WPEX2023.description_cn: Voluntary Service 义工服务 Children and Youth 儿童与青少年 Open Project 开放项目

WPEX2033.description: The course aims to develop students’ understanding of environmental sustainability issues from local to global scales, and to raise students’ environmental awareness and responsibility in daily life. The course provides students with experiences applying knowledge and skills that are used to explore and investigate a wide range of environmental issues faced at campus or in the community.
WPEX2033.description_cn: Growing Food in a Changing Climate 在变化的气候中的粮 食生长 Marine Conservation 海洋保护 Nature Observation - Bird Watching 自然观察-观鸟 Nature Observation - Plant 自然观察-植物 Wildlife and Human (Conservation Action) 野生动物与人类（保 护行动） Wildlife and Human 野生动植物和人类

WPEX2013.description: This course aims to teach the basis of traditional craft culture and techniques, including historical materials and the application of traditional intangible cultural heritage crafts, so that students can preliminarily understand and understand the concepts, types and modeling characteristics of traditional arts and crafts, and understand the concept of traditional craft aesthetics. Let the students learn the folk art production methods and skills through theory and practice, understand the traditional art, further cultivate students' feelings, experience and appreciation of the craft beauty of the traditional art, and establish a correct aesthetic concept. * Note: Students need to bring their own course tools or purchase course materials (200 yuan/person) As China's market economy started in the early 90, contemporary ink painting rapidly developing and growing form of a special painting form. It has been designed to help students in both "image” and " abstract " on the basis of the concept of modeling and training " image " - style modeling concepts and explore new formal language of contemporary Chinese ink painting. In the course content, Chinese literati painting technique combination with western forms of content, not only can learn the most representative Chinese calligraphy, and will learn through an integrated combination of material and ink painting. The ultimate aim is to hope that our students will be trained to a broader cultural perspective to look at the traditional national culture in the world. *Note: Students need to bring or buy their own materials. (50RMB)
WPEX2013.description_cn: Experiential Arts 艺术体验 Traditional Chinese Craft 传统中国工艺 本课程旨在教授传统工艺文化及技法基础，包含史学资料与 传统非遗工艺技艺的应用，使学生初步了解和认识传统工艺 美术的概念、种类和造型特点及让其了解到传统工艺美学的 理念。让学生通过理论及实践学习民间艺术品的制作方法、 技巧，认识传统艺术，更进一步培养学生对传统艺术的感受 、体验、鉴赏工艺美的能力，树立正确的审美观念。 *注意：学生需自备课程工具或统一购买课程材料（200元/ 人） Watercolor Painting 水彩绘画 创意水彩课程学生在老师的指导下，了解水彩的发展史，掌 握水彩绘画技法，及绘画的构图审美，理论结合实践。透过 水，颜料，纸及各种媒介，抛开对于传统水彩的理解，以新 的表现形式创作设计出一系列以水彩为元素的绘画作品。 课程目标：学生熟练的掌握课程所学的水彩技法，及创新的 绘画表现形式，并以明信片的形式创作出一系列水彩元素的 绘画作品。 *注意：学生需自备水彩工具。

UCHL1013.description: Badminton is a skill dominated by the type of net - wide antagonism of the event, its entertainment, simplicity, exercise and other characteristics by the majority of students like. Badminton sports can develop students' coordination and agility, and cultivate students' good qualities such as fair competition, tenacious struggle, calm and decisive, unity and cooperation. The course is taught in the form of a combination of 28 class hours of in- class practice and 20 class hours of extracurricular practice. This course will familiarize students with the basic skills, tactics, rules of the game and the rules of the referee. Students will be led to apply fundamental sports science knowledge in analyzing and enhancing their performance. The course provides students with an understanding of the training methods for badminton, according to the project characteristics of the badminton introduces general functional training and sports injury prevention and recovery. Moreover, the course provides students with knowledge on healthy lifestyle, suggestions on how to develop an exercise habit, and how racket sports such as badminton can contribute as life-long physical activities.
UCHL1013.description_cn: 羽毛球是一项以球技为主的隔网对抗型项目，其娱乐性、简 洁性、运动性等特点受到广大学生的喜爱。羽毛球运动可以 培养学生的协调性和敏捷性，培养学生公平竞争、顽强奋斗 、冷静果断、团结合作等良好素质。本课程以28学时的课堂 实践和20学时的课外实践相结合的形式进行教学，使学生熟 悉足球的基本技术、战术、比赛规则和裁判规则。学生将被 引导运用基本的运动科学知识来分析和提高他们的能力 。此 外，本课程让学生了解羽毛球运动的训练方法，根据羽毛球 运动的项目特点，介绍一般功能训练和运动损伤的预防与恢 复。该课程为学生提供健康生活方式的知识，如何养成运动 习惯的建议，以及羽毛球等使用球拍类运动如何成为终身体 育活动。

UCHL1023.description: This course aims to acquaint students with the basic knowledge of basketball. It also provides students with an understanding of basic nutrition in relation to healthy living. Students will learn how to apply basic sports science knowledge in analyzing techniques and plays. In addition, through group games students will have opportunities to appreciate teamwork in basketball. Upon completion of the course, students will develop a sense of confidence in participating in basketball; develop an appreciation of different offensive and defensive plays of the game; understand the importance of physical fitness as it relates to team sports; and adopt an active healthy lifestyle.
UCHL1023.description_cn: 本课程旨在使学生掌握篮球的基本知识，让学生了解与健康 生活有关的基本营养学知识。学生将学习如何运用基本的运 动科学知识来分析技术和比赛。此外，通过小组比赛，学生 将有机会观赏篮球团队合作。完成课程后，学生将提高参与 篮球运动的信心；培养对不同进攻和防守战术的鉴赏能力； 了解身体健康在团队运动中的重要性；采取积极健康的生活 方式。

UCHL1033.description: This course teaches swimming theory and tactics, methods and means of physical exercise, scientific and healthy lifestyle, sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, to cultivate students' sports awareness, provide theoretical and technical support for students on how to live an active and healthy life, and enable students to actively and purposefully participate in sports activities.
UCHL1033.description_cn: 本课程讲授游泳的理论与战术、体育锻炼的方法与手段、科 学健康的生活方式、运动损伤的预防与康复，培养学生的体 育意识，为学生如何积极健康地生活提供理论和技术支持， 使学生能够积极、有目的地参加体育活动。

UCHL1043.description: This course teaches swimming theory and tactics, methods and means of physical exercise, scientific and healthy lifestyle, sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, to cultivate students' sports awareness, provide theoretical and technical support for students on how to live an active and healthy life, and enable students to actively and purposefully participate in sports activities.
UCHL1043.description_cn: 课程旨在教授学生拉拉操的各种技术技能，基本规则，使学 生能够作为拉拉队员表演。通过每节课的学习，学生逐渐获 得相关知识和经验，能够在娱乐或比赛中与其他拉拉队队员 进行表演和合作。通过学习，促进学生的身体健康，培养终 身锻炼的理念，体会团队合作的快乐，并通过啦啦操活动提 高学生的体质和健康水平。这类课程的核心是通过培养积极 健康生活方式的知识、技能和态度，有目的地让学生参与体

UCHL1053.description: This course teaches swimming theory and tactics, methods and means of physical exercise, scientific and healthy lifestyle, sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, to cultivate students' sports awareness, provide theoretical and technical support for students on how to live an active and healthy life, and enable students to actively and purposefully participate in sports activities.
UCHL1053.description_cn: 本课程旨在教授学员各种气功的技术技能，使学员在练习气 功的过程中，能够熟练地运用各种基本功。通过学习，学生 逐渐掌握进学生的身心健康，提高学生的体质和健康水平。 它通过知识、技能和态度来学生培养积极健康的生活方式 的，使学生参与体育活动。

UCHL1063.description: The course aims to help students develop the lifelong-exercise habit and interest, providing brand-new eyesight of fitness, grasp practical training skills and improve their health level scientifically. Students will gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience of weightlifting and fitness through each lesson. In addition, the training plan for students will be modulated according to the prior fitness level of students to make sure each student obtains certain improvement. After accomplishing the fitness lesson, students will cherish their health more. They can not only learn fitness training skills, but also make a training plan to improve their health level safely and effectively.
UCHL1063.description_cn: 本课程旨在帮助学生培养终身运动的习惯和兴趣，提供全新 的健身视野，掌握实用的训练技巧，科学地提高学生的健康 水平。通过每节课的学习，学生逐渐掌握举重运动和健身知 识和经验。此外，根据学生的前期体能水平调整训练计划， 确保每位学生都有一定的提高。完成健身课程后，学生会更 加珍惜自己的健康。他们不仅可以学习健身训练技能，还可 以制定训练计划，安全有效地提高自己的健康水平。

UCHL1073.description: The course aims to teach students various technical skills of orienteering, and the basic rules and strategies that enable students to practice and perform orienteering. The course also intends to help students to gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience of orienteering through each class and practice, and enable students to perform and cooperate with other students for recreation or orienteering competition. Upon completion of the course, students will develop a sense of confidence in participating in the orienteering sport; develop an appreciation of the sport; understand the importance of physical fitness as it relates to the sport; and adopt an active healthy lifestyle.
UCHL1073.description_cn: 本课程旨在教授学生定向运动的各种技术技能，使学生能够 练习和运用定向运动的基本规则和策略。通过每节课学习和 每一次练习，学生逐渐掌握定向越野知识和经验，能够表演 和通过与其他学生合作进行娱乐或定向越野比赛。完成课程 后，学生能有信心地参加定向越野运动；培养对这项运动的 兴趣；了解这项运动对身体健康的重要性；采取积极健康的 生活方式。

UCHL1083.description: Pilates is a physical exercise that helps people return to their busy lives with a sense of energy. It develops a disciplined and healthy lifestyle through physical training. This course is designed to help students understand the benefits of Pilates breathing, stretching and strength exercises, and to learn these motion techniques. The students will master the exercise of Pilates at basic and intermediate level, and also master proper stretching methods. The course will develop students' ability to focus, enhance their flexibility, especially spinal flexibility, improve their core control, shape their form, and improve their temperament. The course will also cultivate students' ability of innovation, sense of teamwork, sense of competition, and sense of art. Out-of-class assignments will be given to incorporate the benefits of Pilates into students` daily life, for example taking Pilates breaths, doing the roll up, or doing balance exercises three to five times a day.
UCHL1083.description_cn: 普拉提是一种体育锻炼，可以帮助人们在忙碌的生活中恢复 精力。它通过体育锻炼培养一种纪律和健康的生活方式。本 课程旨在帮助学生了解普拉提呼吸，伸展和力量练习的好 处，并学习这些运动技术。学生将掌握初级和中级普拉提的 练习，掌握适当的拉伸方法。该课程将培养学生的专注能 力，增强他们的柔韧性，特别是脊柱柔韧性，提高他们的核 心控制，塑造他们的形态，改善他们的气质。培养学生的创 新能力、团队意识、竞争意识和艺术意识。课外作业将把普 拉提的好处融入到学生的日常生活中，例如，每天做三到五 次普拉提呼吸，做卷腹，或做平衡练习。

UCHL1093.description: This course teaches rugby theory and tactics, methods and means of physical exercise, scientific and healthy lifestyle, sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, to cultivate students' sports awareness, provide theoretical and technical support for students on how to live an active and healthy life, and enable students to actively and purposefully participate in sports activities.
UCHL1093.description_cn: 本课程讲授橄榄球的理论与战术、体育锻炼的方法与手段、 科学健康的生活方式、运动损伤的预防与康复，培养学生的 体育意识，为学生如何积极健康地生活提供理论和技术支 持，使学生能够积极、有目的地参与体育活动。

UCHL1103.description: This course aims to help students adopt a healthy lifestyle through physical exercise, while learning and practicing self defence, including self defence concepts, self defence common sense and self defence skills. To learn unarmed defence can minimize damages in emergency situations, and students can apply the taught self defence skills for the purpose of self- protection when in danger. Through active practical experiences, the course also expects to promote the idea of lifelong exercises, and improve students’ fitness and wellness through the self defence activity.
UCHL1103.description_cn: 本课程旨在通过体育锻炼帮助学生养成健康的生活方式 ，同 时学习和练习防身术，包括防身术概念、常识和技能。学习 徒手防御可以在紧急情况下最大限度地减少损失，学生可以 运用所教的防身技能在危险中进行自我保护。通过学习，该 课程还希望推广终身锻炼的理念，并通过防身术活动提高学 生的体质和健康。

UCHL1113.description: The course aims to teach students various technical skills in table tennis and the basic rules of the game. The course also intends to help students to gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience in table tennis through each lesson, and enable students to play by themselves for recreation or competition. Through positive practical experiences, the course also promotes the idea of lifelong exercises and improves fitness and wellness of students through table tennis activity.
UCHL1113.description_cn: 本课程旨在教授学生各种乒乓球技术及基本比赛规则。通过 每节课的学习，学生逐渐掌握乒乓球知识和经验，能够享受 这项运动或比赛。课程还推广终身锻炼的理念，通过乒乓球 活动提高学生的体质和健康水平。

UCHL1123.description: The course aims to teach students various technical skills in table tennis and the basic rules of the game. The course also intends to help students to gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience in table tennis through each lesson, and enable students to play by themselves for recreation or competition. Through positive practical experiences, the course also promotes the idea of lifelong exercises and improves fitness and wellness of students through table tennis activity.
UCHL1123.description_cn: 本课程旨在透过参与网球运动，让学生了解健康的生活方式 及如何积极运动。课程不仅会介绍网球的基本技巧，还会提 供不同的游戏，让学生在课堂上活跃起来，体验锻炼的好处 。网球是一项很好的有氧运动，可以提高反应能力、平衡能 力和协调性。学生将在课堂上通过任务或游戏体验兴奋和快 乐。与同学组成团队也会加强学生的社会联系。完成课程 后，学生应养成锻炼的习惯，这对改善和保持身体健康至关 重要。

UCHL1133.description: The course aims to teach students various technical skills in Yoga and the basic rules to practice Yoga in different environments. The course also intends to help students gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience, and enable students to practice Yoga by themselves for health promotion or sports competition. Through positive practical experiences, the course also expects to promote the idea of lifelong exercises and improve fitness and wellness of students through Yoga and Asana practice.
UCHL1133.description_cn: 本课程旨在教授学生瑜伽的各种技术技能，以及在不同环境 下练习瑜伽的基本规则。课程还帮助学生逐渐获得丰富的知 识和经验，使学生能够自己练习瑜伽，以促进自身健康或参 加体育比赛。课程还希望通过瑜伽和体式练习，促进终身锻 炼的理念，提高学生的健身和健康。

UCHL1143.description: Good health-related aerobic dancing and regular dancing activity are important for optimal wellness. They can not only help improve strength and endurance as well as stretch and flexibility, but also promote quality of life and well-being. This course aims to help students to acquire recognition and appreciation of the beauty of the body, and a good understanding and response to music. It also provides students with an understanding of the principles of a healthy lifestyle for achieving physical health and well-being by participating in Aerobic Dancing. Upon completion of this course, students will gain practical experience in a variety of basic dance movements including Zumba, Jazz, Salsa, and have a good understanding of a healthy lifestyle.
UCHL1143.description_cn: 有氧舞蹈不仅有助于提高力量和耐力以及伸展和灵活性 ，还 可以提高生活质量和幸福感。本课程旨在帮助学生获得对身 体美的认可和欣赏，以及对音乐的理解和反应。同时，让学 生了解通过参加有氧舞蹈可以达到身体健康和幸福的目的 。 完成本课程后，学生将学会各种基本舞蹈动作，包括尊巴舞 、爵士舞、萨尔萨舞，并对健康的生活方式有很好的理解。

UCHL1153.description: This course aims to provide students with a basic understanding of a healthy lifestyle and ways to develop a physically active life by participating in football. The course will introduce various technical skills in football and the basic rules of the game. The course also intends to help students to gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience in football through each lesson, and enable students to play by themselves for recreation or competition. Through positive practical experiences, the course also promotes the idea of lifelong exercises and improves fitness and wellness of students through football activity.
UCHL1153.description_cn: 本课程旨在让学生了解健康的生活方式以及通过参加足球运 动来拓展体育活动。本课程将介绍足球的各种技术技能和比 赛的基本规则，帮助学生学习足球知识和获得相应的技能， 使学生能够自己踢球进行娱乐或比赛。该课程还推广终身锻 炼的理念，通过足球活动提高学生的体质和健康。

UCHL1163.description: This course provides student with knowledge of body controls, being flexible, and proper body posture that relates and contributes to well-being and healthy lifestyle of individuals. Students will be instructed to comprehend skills using big exercise ball. The body training and exercises on an unstable and bouncing ball will improve core strength and body control. Additionally, it contributes to the correction of body posture and increases flexibility and body balance. Meditation exercises with fitness ball will not just bring relaxation of mood and release of stress, but also ensure movement flow and coherency, which ignite the harmony between mind and body. Moreover, this course is designed to provide students with an understanding of the principles of a healthy lifestyle for achieving physical health and wellness.
UCHL1163.description_cn: 本课程为学生提供身体掌控、灵活度和身体动作的知识，这 些知识与个人的幸福感和健康生活方式有关并有助于提高他 们健康的生活方式。该课程将指导学生理解使用大型健身球 的技巧。在不稳定和弹跳的球上进行身体训练和锻炼，提高 核心力量和身体控制能力。此外，它有助于纠正身体姿势， 增加灵活性和身体平衡。健身球冥想练习不仅能放松心情， 释放压力，还能保证动作的流畅性和连贯性，点燃身心和谐 。此外，本课程旨在让学生了解实现身体健康的健康生活方 式的理论。

UCHL1173.description: The course aims to teach students various technical skills in Ultimate Frisbee and the basic rules of the game. The course also intends to help students to gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience in Ultimate Frisbee through each lesson, and enable students to play by themselves for recreation or competition. Through positive practical experiences, the course also promotes the idea of lifelong exercises and improves fitness and wellness of students through Ultimate Frisbee activity.
UCHL1173.description_cn: 该课程旨在教授学生极限飞盘的各种技术技能和游戏的基本 规则。通过学习，学生逐渐掌握满意的极限飞盘知识和经 验，能够自行进行娱乐或比赛。课程还推广终身锻炼的理 念，并通过极限飞盘活动提高学生的体能和健康水平。

UCHL1183.description: The course aims to teach students the technical skills and basic knowledge of kayaking and similar boating sport activities. It further intends to encourage students to adopt a positive attitude and healthy lifestyle, cultivate students' self-motivation, self-knowledge and team spirit, and improve their physical abilities, including reaction, balance, coordination and endurance. Students experience excitement and pleasure through challenges and games, while teamwork, perseverance, leadership and a sense of adventure will be promoted through this process.
UCHL1183.description_cn: 本课程旨在教授学生皮划艇及类似划船运动的技术技巧和基 本知识，鼓励学生养成积极向上的生活态度和健康的生活方 式，培养学生的自我激励、自我认知和团队精神，提高学生 的反应能力、平衡能力、协调能力和耐力。学生通过挑战游 戏体验课程中的兴奋和快乐，同时团队合作、毅力、领导能 力和冒险意识将在这个过程中得到提升。

UCHL1193.description: Outdoor leadership is to challenge oneself to lead a team, face adversity, and savor the relationships formed in the wild. This course begins with the fundamentals, forming a foundation that enables students to step forward with the skills and knowledge to lead others toward a common goal. The extended outdoor course environment provides an ideal opportunity for developing leadership skills through a progression where each student observes, applies, and discusses leadership techniques. Upon completion of the course, students will be able to serve a team in a variety of roles of leadership; demonstrate good outdoor leadership skills, including expedition behavior, communication, judgement and decision making, tolerance for adversity and uncertainty; take responsibility for the well-being of themselves and others; understand the relationship between human beings and nature; and adopt an active healthy lifestyle.
UCHL1193.description_cn: 户外领导力是挑战自己，带领团队，面对逆境，享受野外生 活的一门课程。本课程从基础知识开始开始学习，使学生能 够凭借技能和知识向前迈进，带领他人实现共同目标。扩展 的户外课程环境为每个学生提供了一个发展领导技能的机会 。完成课程后，学生将能够为团队服务，担任各种领导角 色；表现出良好的户外领导技能，包括探险行为、沟通、判 断和决策、对逆境和不确定性的忍耐力；对自己和他人的健 康负责；理解人与自然的关系；采取积极健康的生活方式。

UCHL1203.description: The course aims to enable students to learn and master basic knowledge and skills of sport climbing, and become proficient in climbing safety techniques and climbing safety management. Students will achieve a better physical and mental state when participating in climbing activities, and understand the related knowledge of climbing training, and be able to develop a basic training plan for themselves. After completing the course, students will be able to understand the benefits of sport climbing toward improving health and daily physical exercise. Students will develop a sense of confidence in participating in sport climbing, develop an appreciation of the sport, understand the importance of physical fitness as it relates to the sport, and adopt an active healthy lifestyle.
UCHL1203.description_cn: 本课程旨在使学生学习和掌握运动攀岩的基本知识和技能 ， 熟练掌握攀岩安全技术和攀岩安全管理。使学生在参加攀岩 活动时达到更好的身心状态，了解攀岩训练的相关知识，能 够为自己制定基本的训练计划。完成课程后，学生将能够了 解运动攀岩对改善健康和日常体育锻炼的好处。学生将在参 与运动攀岩时建立信心，培养对这项运动的欣赏，了解身体 健康的重要性。

UCHL1213.description: The course is offered to students whose mobility/sensory/health needs special teaching and learning attention. It aims to teach students various technical skills of weight and fitness training, and the basic safety rules that enable them to operate different weight equipment. The course also provides an understanding of the benefits of the Fitness exercise for students with mobility/sensory/health needs, skills to participate in exercise, and knowledge of rehabilitation. Through positive practical experiences, the course also promotes the idea of lifelong exercises, and improves students’ fitness and wellness through special weight and fitness exercises.
UCHL1213.description_cn: 该课程面向身心需要特殊教学和关注的学生。它旨在向学生 传授健身训练的各种技术技能，使他们能够掌握操作不同重 量设备的基本安全规则。该课程还为有运动/感官/健康特殊 需求的学生提供了了解健身锻炼、参与锻炼的技能和康复的 相关知识。该课程还推广终身锻炼的理念，并通过特殊的锻 炼方式提高学生的体质和健康。

UCHL1223.description: This course aims to help students learn various technical skills in Dragon and Lion Dance, including dance movements and routines, team work, and basic drum play. At the same time, the course introduces the cultural background and philosophy of Dragon and Lion Dance, and emphasizes sportsmanship values, such as fair-play, mutual respects, solidarity and friendship. Through positive practical experiences, the course also expects to promote the idea of lifelong exercises, as students enjoy the happiness of team work, and improve their fitness and wellness through the Dragon and Lion Dance activities.
UCHL1223.description_cn: 本课程旨在帮助学生学习舞龙舞狮的各种技术技能，包括动 作和策略、团队合作和基本的打鼓方式。同时，课程介绍舞 龙舞狮的文化背景和哲学理论，强调公平竞争、相互尊重、 团结友爱等体育精神价值观。该课程还希望推广终身锻炼的 理念，让学生享受团队合作的快乐，通过舞龙舞狮活动提高 他们的体能和健康。

UCHL1243.description: This course aims to acquaint students with the basic knowledge of golf. It also provides students with an understanding of basic nutrition in relation to healthy living. Students will learn how to apply basic golf techniques, tactics, swing principles and fundamental sports science knowledge in analyzing techniques and plays. In addition, by watching and participating in golf competitions, students will have the opportunity to appreciate and experience the team cooperation, golf spirit and sports spirit of golf. This course will cultivate students' interest and confidence in participating in golf; cultivate students' appreciation of different offensive and defensive tactics in the game; let students understand the importance of physical fitness and learn to adopt a positive and healthy lifestyle. It will lay a good foundation for students' physical, psychological and social adaptability in the future. *Students should make sure that they do not have class an hour before the start time of this course. Besides, students should pay the course fee RMB 800 (transporation, rent).
UCHL1243.description_cn: 本课程旨在使学生熟悉高尔夫的基本知识，使学生了解与健 康生活有关的相关营养知识。学生将学习如何将基本的高尔 夫技术、战术、挥杆原理和基本的体育科学知识应用于分析 技术和比赛中。此外，通过观看和参加高尔夫比赛，学生将 有机会欣赏和体验高尔夫的团队合作、高尔夫精神和体育精 神。本课程将培养学生参与高尔夫运动的兴趣和信心；培养 学生对比赛中不同攻防战术的鉴赏力；让学生了解身体素质 的重要性，并学会积极健康的生活方式。它将为学生未来的 身体、心理和社会适应能力奠定良好的基础。 *学生需支付课程费用包括交通费、高尔夫球场地租赁费。

UCHL1263.description: This course teaches swimming theory and tactics, methods and means of physical exercise, scientific and healthy lifestyle, sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, to cultivate students' sports awareness, provide theoretical and technical support for students on how to live an active and healthy life, and enable students to actively and purposefully participate in sports activities.
UCHL1263.description_cn: 本课程讲授游泳的理论与战术、体育锻炼的方法与手段、科 学健康的生活方式、运动损伤的预防与康复，培养学生的体 育意识，为学生如何积极健康地生活提供理论和技术支持， 使学生能够积极、有目的地参加体育活动。

UCHL1303.description: This course aims to help students adopt a healthy lifestyle through physical exercise. Apart from learning the archery technique, students will benefit from this course physically and mentally, such as shaping an upright body- gesture, strengthening their physical health, embodying a positive attitude and ways of being a human, and nourishing an essential personality, which is calm, concentrated, patient, courageous and self-motivated.
UCHL1303.description_cn: 本课程旨在通过体育锻炼，帮助学生养成健康的生活方式。 在学习射箭技术的同时，学员在身心上也将受益，如塑造端 正的身体姿态，增强体质，体现积极向上的做人态度和做人 方式，培养冷静、专注、耐心、勇敢、上进的基本人格。

UCHL1323.description: The course aims to teach students to learn various technical skills in Volleyball and the basic rules enable students to perform the essential skills when playing Volleyball. The course also intends to help students gradually to acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience of Volleyball through each lesson, and enable students to perform and cooperate with other Volleyball players for recreation or competition. Through positive practical experiences, the course also expects to promote the idea of lifelong exercises, enjoy the happiness of team work, and improve fitness and wellness of students through Volleyball games.
UCHL1323.description_cn: 本课程旨在教会学生学习排球的各种技术技能，基本规则， 使学生能够掌握基本技能。该课程还旨在帮助学生逐渐获得 排球知识和经验，使学生能够在娱乐或比赛中与其他排球运 动员进行表演和合作。通过实践，本课程还希望推广终身锻 炼的理念，享受团队合作的快乐，提高学生的体质和健康。

UCHL1353.description: This course aims to provide students with a basic understanding of a healthy lifestyle and ways to develop a physically active life by participating in Pickleball. It is always easy to start doing exercise but hard to keep it as a regular basis. Therefore, the course will introduce not only the basic skills of Pickleball, but also provide different games to let students get active in class and experience the benefit of exercising. Pickleball is a good aerobic exercise and can improve reflexes, balance and coordination. Students will experience the excitement and happiness through tasks or games in class. Forming teams with classmates will also enhance students' social connection. Upon completion of the course, students shall develop the habit of exercising, which is vital to improve and maintain physical health.
UCHL1353.description_cn: 本课程旨在通过让学生参与匹克球运动，帮助他们初步理解 健康的生活方式，并掌握养成积极运动习惯的方法。开始锻 炼总是容易的，但难在坚持规律运动。因此，本课程不仅会 教授匹克球的基本技能，还会设计多样化的游戏，让同学们 在课堂上活跃起来，亲身感受运动带来的益处。匹克球是一 项良好的有氧运动，能够提高反应速度、平衡能力和身体协 调性。通过课堂上的任务或游戏，学生将体验到运动的激情 与快乐。与同学组队还能增强社交联系。完成本课程后，学 生应能养成锻炼的习惯，这对于改善和维持身体健康至关重 要

ENG1083.description: This course aims to improve students’ ability to describe the specific features and trends found in infographics in writing, as well as to write summaries about the information presented in various kinds of infographics - including a variety of charts, diagrams, graphs, tables, maps, and floo r plans. The course will utilise infographics related to various topics offline and online. The primary focus will be on written descriptions and summaries, although there will also be opportunities for students to verbally discuss their ideas of how to re present the specific features, data and organization of each individual infographic.

ENG3283.description: English Through Critical Thinking is an advanced language course designed to facilitate the improvement of students ’ skills in logic and argumentation. The course is as an introduction to various elements of critical thinking including argument identification, argument assessment, fallacy evaluation and argument recon struction. In developing these skills, students will apply critical thinking to real -life situations and written texts that will help to develop their understanding of the English language. Students should also expect to improve their confidence and clarity in both spoken and written English. The overall aim is to educate students on how to use critical thinking in English to improve their own arguments, as well as to identify and evaluate arguments in written texts.

ENG3293.description: This course focuses on assisting students to develop effective language strategies so that they can perform at a high standard in international language tests and improve the effectiveness of their communication in English more generally. To achieve these objectives, the course emphasises the core competencies that are essential to the development of language skills (particularly those relevant to speaking and writing) a nd explores a range of different learning strategies and approaches to language study and testing in detail.

ENG3803.description: Please remember this entire course is based on developin g general second language speaking skills rather than assessing specific academic content. This course aims to prepare students for communicating in a spoken context within an academic environment, with a particular focus on developing and strengthening li stening skills. The objectives are to provide students with linguistic skills to interpret and respond appropriately to auditory input and to convey their ideas effectively and fluently when speaking.

ENG2233.description: This course aims to equip undergraduate students with the necessary skills to effectively utilise Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools across various aspects of academic writing. Students will learn specific prompt engineering techniques tailored to academic writing tasks and will develop proficiency in AI -assisted editing to enhance text accuracy while preserving the author’s original voice. They will also learn to employ AI tools for efficient academic research, including literature searches, summarisation, and reference management. Furthermore, the course will enable students to critically analyse ethical considerations related to the use of AI in academic writing. Emphasis will be placed on cultivating independent learning strategies for working with AI, thereby allowing students to further develop their AI -assisted writing skills beyond the classroom environment.

FREN1013.description: This course is intended for complete beginners in French according to the CEFRL (Common European Framework of Reference for languag es) Level A1 (Part 1). It aims at developing basic knowledge in the four areas of competence (listening, speaking, reading and writing) and developing students linguistic, communicative and cultural competence in the target language.

FREN1003.description: This course is a continuation of French I. It aims at developing the four areas of competence (listening, speaking, reading and writing) according to the CEFRL (Common European Framework of Reference f or languages) Level A1 (Part 2) and expanding linguistic, pronunciation and communicative skills. To achieve this, students will be exposed to the fundamentals of grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation and sentence structure. GERM1023 GERMAN I Pre-requisite(s): None (3 units) Course Descriptions: This course is an introduction to German language. Designed for students with no prior knowledge of the German language, the course aims at building students ’ linguistic and communicative skills in the four areas of language learning, i.e. listening, speaking, reading and writing according to CEFR A1.1 (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages) as well as to enable students to apply communication strategies in the target language. Besides, students will gain a brief insight into German speaking culture(s) and develop « cultural literacy » towards the German cultural area at a basic level. GERM1003 GERMAN II Pre-requisite(s): German I (3 units) Course Descriptions: This course builds on German I and compli es with the reference level A1 of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). The course aims at systematically enhancing the students’ skills in the four areas of language learning, i.e. listening, speaking, reading and writing. The course covers topics such as jobs, food, writing a postcard, the weather, booking a room, orientation in a city, shopping, and colours. Students will also be able to gain further insight into German culture in this course. GERM1033 Cultural Theory and Popular Culture- The case of Germany Pre-requisite(s): None (3 units) Course Descriptions: This course explores the evolution of German popular culture from 1945 to the present. Through perspectives of music, film, television, lifestyle, fashion, and digital medi a, students will examine how Germany has grappled with its history, identity, division, and reunification. We will investigate the tension between "high" culture and "low" culture, the influence of Americanization, the unique subcultures of East and West G ermany, and the emergence of a multicultural, modern German identity. Key concepts of cultural theory and popular culture will be introduced and applied to examples from German popular culture after WWII. JAP1013 JAPANESE I Pre-requisite(s): None (3 units) Course Descriptions: This foundation course is designed for beginners who have never studied Japanese before. The Japanese phonetic system, writing system, basic greetings, sente nce structures and practical vocabulary that are suitable for beginners will be introduced in this course. It also provides opportunities for students to understand the main aspects of Japanese culture and to develop the ability to communicate in basic Japanese, e.g., by introducing oneself, daily expressions, telling the time and the date and talking about one’s daily life. Students’ active participation in classroom activities is expected. JAP2003 JAPANESE II Pre-requisite(s): Japanese I (3 units) Course Descriptions: This course builds on Japanese I. It aims to systematically enhance the students’ skills in the four areas of language learning, i.e. listening, speaking, reading, and writing. It is intended to develop students’ practical language skills and their ability to conduct a simple, daily conversation in Japanese by using judgmental, narrative, descriptive, and existential sentences. Moreover, the course seeks to help students to understand simple written Japanese, to develop the ability to write in Japanese, and to improve their overall accomplishments in Japanese for the future. KOR1013 KOREAN I Pre-requisite(s): None (3 units) Course Descriptions: This course is designed for students who have no prior knowledge of Korean language. The primary goal is to help novice learners of Korean language build basic communicative competence by developing their ability to construct language around topics of interest and apply Korean language to real -life situations. Students will learn Hangeul (Korean alphabet), and basic sentence structures needed to develop skills in Korean language learning. Students will learn proper oral and written use of the language, esp ecially in consideration of Korean contexts and cultures. SPAN1013 SPANISH I Pre-requisite(s): None (3 units) Course Descriptions: This course is an introduction to Spanish language. The aim of this course is to introduce beginners to Spanish language building their linguistic and communicative skills in the four language skills: speaking, reading, writing and listening; basic grammar and pronunciation rules, as well as to enable them to apply communication strategies in the target language. Upon succe ssful completion of this course, students will attain the lower range of competency within the Common European Framework of Reference for languages (CEFR) of Spanish Language (A1.1) in the four language skills: reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Students will also gain a view of Spanish and Latin American cultures and develop “intercultural literacy” at a basic level. SPAN1003 Spanish II Pre-requisite(s): Spanish I (3 units) Course Descriptions: The aim of this course is to further develop stude nt’s knowledge of the Spanish language and continue working on the four language skills: listening, speaking, reading and writing skills; as well as a higher range of basic grammar and pronunciation rules. Upon successful completion of this course, studen ts will attain the upper A1 range of competency within the Common European Framework of Reference for languages (CEFR) of Spanish Language (A1.2) in the language skills mentioned above. Students will also gain a view of Spanish and Latin American cultures and develop “intercultural literacy” at an upper basic level. SPAN2023 INTRODUCTION TO SPANISH ARTS AND MONUMENTS Pre-requisite(s): None (3 units) Course Descriptions: This course is designed for students who are interested in Spanish Arts, Monuments and Sites. Spain is one of the countries with the most UNESCO World Heritage Sites and a great example of safeguarding and protecting its heritage. This course will introdu ce and offer an exploration of Spanish past and present in terms of monumental sites. A variety of audio-visual materials will be used and provided during the course in order to facilitate students’ appreciation of the rich Historical Sites and Heritage fr om Spain, from the ancient period to contemporary time using monuments, mythology, traditional legends, and fine arts as the main way of instruction through a timeline. Students will be expected to engage with the course content through discussion, providi ng related topics and relevant opinions about the importance of historical heritage, safeguarding and protection, as well as monuments, fine arts, and heritage appreciation. In this course students are encouraged to broaden their knowledge and worldview of diverse fields taking the Spanish Heritage, Historical Sites, Monuments, Myths and Legends through several Fine Arts as a good example of valuing the past, culture protection and art perception.
